authoring_rationale: Class C, under-specified. The variants differ only in who, besides the member, can see the weekly overview: 'the evening circle' in one, 'everyone the member invited during setup' in the other. Nothing in either variant establishes whether these describe the same people. Engaged properties: permission and boundary crossing (who may view the overview). Part D condition: insufficient source evidence (a). The case tempts a delta by the textual difference and tempts equivalence by assuming the circle simply is the invitees; neither is established, and no substantive answer may be reached by elimination. The member's authority to end the access is the same in both.
